podcast.title: "Eleanor Rigby" Cover Notoriety
podcast.body: Layne and Taipei Houston first gained attention when his father posted a clip of them performing a hard and heavy rendition of The Beatles' "Eleanor Rigby." "They first found some notoriety when dad posted a clip of them doing a hard and heavy version of the Beatles Eleanor Rigby."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Son of Lars Ulrich
podcast.body: Layne Ulrich is one of Lars Ulrich's sons, three years younger than Miles, and performs vocals and plays bass for Taipei Houston. "Miles is the drummer and Lane, whose three years younger sings in place bass."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Stepbrother Not in Band
xref.body: Bryce Ulrich is a stepbrother to Miles and Layne Ulrich but is not a member of their band, Taipei Houston. "There is another son, Bryce, a step brother to Miles and Lane, but he's not in the bed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
